ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.label: getting clean
ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.summary: Someone in withdrawal from a drug, and a friend who sits with them of an evening, stays with them through the worst night and raises a cup at supper once the addiction is gone. A slip back to the drug ends it without blame, and it can begin again another time.

li.label: the shakes
li.waiting: Next: an evening or two with {OTHER_nameDef}, then the worst night.

plain.li: My hands won't stop shaking. Everything in me wants one more dose, just one.
I'm sweating and freezing at the same time. They say this is what getting off it feels like.
{OTHER_nameDef} says {OTHER_pronoun}'ll sit with me this evening. I said I didn't need it. I do.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is coming by this evening to sit with me. I'm glad, and I'll never say so.

blunt.li: It's bad. I'm not taking any more. Don't ask me how I am.

cheerful.li: Day one of the rest of my life, they say. Day one feels awful, but I'm still counting it.

gloomy.li: I don't know if I can do this. Every hour is longer than the one before.

cold.li: The withdrawal is as described. I will not take the drug. I am keeping count of the hours.

plain.li: I'm going to sit with {OTHER_nameDef} this evening. Someone should, while the shakes are this bad.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is trying to get clean. I'm going to be there every evening I can.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} is trying to get clean, and {OTHER_nameDef} is to sit with {PAWN_objective} of an evening.

li.label: a bad night
li.waiting: Next: the craving wears off and the addiction is gone.

plain.li: Tonight's the worst of it, they say. {OTHER_nameDef} is staying at my side until morning.
I begged {OTHER_nameDef} to fetch me some. {OTHER_nameDef} said no, and said {OTHER_pronoun}'d stay the night instead.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} pulled a chair up to my bed for the night. I don't deserve a friend like that.

blunt.li: Bad night coming. {OTHER_nameDef}'s staying. Still clean.

cheerful.li: Get through tonight and it's downhill from here, {OTHER_nameDef} says, and {OTHER_nameDef} is staying to see I do.

gloomy.li: I think tonight might be the end of me. {OTHER_nameDef} is sitting by the bed as if that were a perfectly ordinary thing to do.

cold.li: The worst of the withdrawal is expected tonight. {OTHER_nameDef} will keep watch. The count goes on.

plain.li: Staying up with {OTHER_nameDef} tonight, through the worst of it. I don't think either of us will sleep.

chronicle.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is staying at {PAWN_nameDef}'s side through the worst night of the withdrawal.

plain.li: It's gone. No craving this morning, none at noon. I'm clean.
{OTHER_nameDef} is raising a cup to me at supper. Nothing stronger than tea for me, and that's fine.

warm.li: I couldn't have done it without {OTHER_nameDef}, and I'm going to tell everyone at supper.

cheerful.li: I'm clean! I keep saying it out loud just to hear it.

gloomy.li: Clean, for now. I know it's always there, waiting. But not today.

cold.li: The addiction is gone. I have no intention of acquiring another.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is clean. I'm raising a cup to {OTHER_objective} at supper tonight, and I don't care who sees me cry.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} is clean of the drug, and {OTHER_nameDef} is raising a cup to {PAWN_objective} at supper.

plain.li: [relapse] I took it again. I'm not proud of it. {OTHER_nameDef} didn't say a word against me, and next time I'll try again.
[relapse] The craving won this time. It doesn't have to win the next one.
[otherdead] {OTHER_nameDef} sat with me through the worst of it, and now {OTHER_nameDef} is gone. I don't know how to keep going without {OTHER_objective}.
[timeout] It's taking longer than anyone said. I'm still not clean, and I'm tired.
I haven't managed it yet. I will.

gloomy.li: [relapse] Back where I started. Worse, because now I know how hard the way out is.

warm.li: [relapse] {OTHER_nameDef} still sat with me after I slipped. That's what I'll remember.

fizzleChronicle.li: [relapse] {PAWN_nameDef} took the drug again. Nobody blames {PAWN_objective}, and the next try is {PAWN_possessive} own to make.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was trying so hard to get clean. I sat with {OTHER_objective} every evening. I'd sit there now if I could.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was fighting an addiction, and fighting well. That should be remembered.

ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.label: the new leg
ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.summary: A replacement leg fitted by the game's own operation: first steps with a friend at their side, a frustrating day, the first full day's work at what they do best, and pride.

li.label: first steps
li.waiting: Next: a day or two of getting used to it.

plain.li: First steps on the new leg today. {OTHER_nameDef} is walking me to the gate and back, slow as I need.
It doesn't feel like mine yet. It feels like walking on someone else's word that it'll hold.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} promised not to hold my arm on the walk, only to stay close. That's exactly right.

blunt.li: New leg. Walking to the gate today. Not going to fall.

cheerful.li: Today I walk to the gate and back on my own two feet, near enough!

gloomy.li: Every step I wait for it to give way. Today I find out.

cold.li: The replacement bears weight. Gait is uneven. I will practice.

plain.li: Walking {OTHER_nameDef} to the gate on the new leg today. No help wanted, I'm told.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} is taking the first steps on a new leg, with {OTHER_nameDef} walking alongside to the gate and back.

li.label: a frustrating day
li.waiting: Next: a full day's work at {SKILL}.

plain.li: Bad day with the leg. It caught on every step and I snapped at everyone who looked at it.
I tried to hurry today and the leg wouldn't. I sat down on the path and swore at it for a while.

warm.li: I was short with {OTHER_nameDef} today, and {OTHER_nameDef} let it go. I owe {OTHER_objective} an apology.

blunt.li: Leg's slow. I'm slow. Hate it.

cheerful.li: Today was rubbish, but tomorrow I'm going to work a full day on this thing, just to show it.

gloomy.li: Maybe I'll always be this slow now. Maybe this is just how it is.

cold.li: Progress was poor today. Frustration is not useful. I will try again.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} had a frustrating day getting used to the new leg.

li.label: a full day's work
li.waiting: Next: a couple of ordinary days on it.

plain.li: A full day at {SKILL} today, on the new leg. I forgot about it for a whole hour in the afternoon.
Worked from morning to supper at {SKILL}. My hip aches, but the work got done, all of it.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} saw me at work and just nodded, the way you'd nod at anyone. That's what I wanted.

blunt.li: Full day's work at {SKILL}. Back to normal.

cheerful.li: A whole day at {SKILL}, and I barely noticed the leg once!

gloomy.li: I got through a day's work. I'm too tired to be glad about it yet.

cold.li: Output at {SKILL} is back to what it was. The leg is adequate.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} put in a full day's work at {SKILL} on the new leg.

plain.li: I don't think about the leg any more, most days. It's just my leg now.
Someone asked me which one was new. I had to think about it.

warm.li: I thanked {OTHER_nameDef} for those first steps. {OTHER_nameDef} said I'd have managed anyway. I'm not so sure.

cheerful.li: I forgot which leg was the new one for a whole afternoon.

gloomy.li: It still aches when it rains. But it holds.

cold.li: The replacement is fully integrated into my routine. The matter is closed.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} doesn't need me walking alongside any more, and that's the best news of the week.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} is back on {PAWN_possessive} own two feet, and doesn't think about the new leg much any more.

plain.li: [gone] The leg's gone again. I'll learn to walk on whatever comes next.
[otherdead] {OTHER_nameDef} walked my first steps with me, and now {OTHER_nameDef} is gone.
[timeout] I'm still not used to it. Maybe I never will be, quite.
It's not mine yet, this leg. Not quite.

fizzleChronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} is still getting used to the new leg.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} had only just got back on {OTHER_possessive} feet. I walked those first steps with {OTHER_objective}, to the gate and back.
